design_system.name: Swiss Utility
design_system.description: A high-contrast, precision-focused design system inspired by Swiss International Style. It prioritizes content hierarchy, grid alignment, and functional clarity over decoration. The aesthetic is 'Control Room' meets 'Art Gallery'.

usage.primary: Main actions (Submit, Create), Active states, Brand highlights
usage.secondary: Secondary actions (Cancel, Back), Backgrounds for cards

buttons.base: inline-flex items-center justify-center whitespace-nowrap text-sm font-medium ring-offset-background transition-colors focus-visible:outline-none focus-visible:ring-2 focus-visible:ring-ring focus-visible:ring-offset-2 disabled:pointer-events-none disabled:opacity-50

variants.default: bg-primary text-primary-foreground hover:bg-primary/90 h-10 px-6 py-2 uppercase tracking-wider
variants.outline: border border-input bg-background hover:bg-accent hover:text-accent-foreground h-10 px-6 py-2 uppercase tracking-wider
variants.link: text-primary underline-offset-4 hover:underline h-10 px-0 py-2

inputs.base: flex h-10 w-full border border-input bg-background px-3 py-2 text-sm ring-offset-background file:border-0 file:bg-transparent file:text-sm file:font-medium placeholder:text-muted-foreground focus-visible:outline-none focus-visible:ring-1 focus-visible:ring-ring disabled:cursor-not-allowed disabled:opacity-50 rounded-none focus:border-primary transition-colors

universal_guidelines: Do not use gradients for backgrounds; use solid colors or subtle noise textures.
Ensure all interactive elements have a `data-testid` attribute.
Use 'Control Room' grid density for dashboards.
Use 'Tetris' grid asymmetry for marketing pages.
Never center text by default; prefer left alignment for readability.
Use 2x-3x more padding than standard Tailwind defaults.
design_system.instructions_to_main_agent: Follow the 'Swiss Utility' design system. Implement the 'Control Room' grid for the dashboard and 'Tetris' grid for the landing page. Use the specified color palette and typography. Ensure all components are accessible and responsive. Use the provided image URLs for placeholders.
